RFC2132-2-1.note: The sentence binds options defined subsequent to RFC 2132 (an obligation on later option authors, like RFC 7606 section 8). TestEveryEmittedOptionHasLengthOctet walks the reply by length octet over codes 53/54/1/3/6/15/51/58/59, all defined in RFC 2132 itself; buildReply/appendPXEOptions (internal/plugins/dhcpserver/handler.go) emit no later-defined option. The test proves the general section 2 TLV format, which is not this row's obligation; the row reads not-applicable and the tag has no row stating what it proves

RFC2132-2-2.note: TestASCIIOptionParsingTolerantOfTrailingNull feeds option 60 and 77 values with a trailing NUL to isPXEClient/isIPXE (the only ze receivers of ASCII option data) and asserts they are still recognized; an exact-equality matcher without NUL deletion fails it

RFC2132-2-3.note: TestASCIIOptionParsingTolerantOfTrailingNull asserts option 60 and 77 values without a trailing NUL are recognized by isPXEClient/isIPXE; a receiver requiring the NUL fails it

RFC2132-3.3-1.note: TestOptionSubnetMaskBeforeRouter asserts option 1's first byte offset precedes option 3's in a real OFFER from handle(); a reordering of buildReply fails it. single-polarity annotated (no path emits them reversed)

RFC2132-3.5-1.note: TestEmittedIPListOptionLengthsMultipleOfFour asserts the emitted router option length is a non-zero multiple of 4 and exactly 4 for the single configured router; a truncated encoding fails it. single-polarity annotated

RFC2132-3.8-1.note: TestEmittedIPListOptionLengthsMultipleOfFour asserts the emitted DNS option length is a non-zero multiple of 4 and exactly 8 for two configured servers. single-polarity annotated

RFC2132-8.4-1.note: TestIgnoresClientVendorSpecificOption43 asserts the OFFER for a DISCOVER carrying client option 43 is byte-identical to the OFFER without it, through handle(); any action on or rejection of option 43 fails it

RFC2132-9.13-1.note: TestIgnoresUnknownVendorClass (PXE enabled) asserts an unrecognized vendor class 'MSFT 5.0' yields an OFFER byte-identical to one without option 60 and no option 66/67; class-driven handling fails it
